owner_calls.question: Step 3 (X-Men: Apocalypse) marks the 1983 Four Horsemen 'Deceased', but only Angel dies: Psylocke survives and leaves, and Storm and Magneto turn on Apocalypse and live. The group disbands rather than dies, and the Raft has no 'Disbanded' status. Which status should the group file end on?
options: Keep 'Deceased' (the group as a unit is finished, and its leader is dead)
Change to 'Missing' (the group breaks up, and its surviving members go their own ways)
Change to 'Allied' (two of the three surviving members join the X-Men)
owner_calls.evidence: Wikipedia: Psylocke manages to jump safely and escape, but Angel is killed in the plane crash; Lehnsherr and Ororo turn on En Sabah Nur. X-Men Movies Wiki gives the 1983 team's status as 'Disbanded', with Psylocke 'defected' and Storm and Magneto 'formerly' members.
